title: Change of variables for Hausdorff integrals over a blow-up image
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let ℝ^P carry its Borel σ-algebra, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set (no measurability assumed), let x ∈ ℝ^P, let r > 0, and let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be an arbitrary function. Write Hⁿ = μHE[n] and η_{x,r}(y) := r⁻¹(y − x) (SimonGMT Chapter03.blowUpMap x r). Then ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dHⁿ = (r⁻¹)ⁿ ∫_M f(η_{x,r}(y)) dHⁿ(y). Here ∫_A g dHⁿ is the Bochner integral of g against the restricted measure Hⁿ⌞A, and a function that is not integrable has integral 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f y ∂μHE[n] = r⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ y in M, f (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r y) ∂μHE[n]
